$comment: Generated by scripts/build-spec.mjs from the component sources — do not edit by hand.

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: Several sections people scan by heading and open one or two of: FAQs, settings groups, long details.

instead.use: show it — don’t hide the main path

components.name: Alert
components.summary: A message about this page or section that stays until it’s resolved.

instead.when: A confirmation that something just happened
A decision that blocks the page

components.name: AlertDialog
components.summary: Confirming one deliberate, usually destructive or irreversible action before it happens.

instead.when: Deletes people should type the name to confirm
Forms or anything to read at length

components.name: AnimatedIcon
components.summary: A small cue that answers an action: Copy turns into a tick, a menu button folds into ×, a refresh arrow turns.

instead.when: Every icon on the screen — motion stops meaning anything
The only signal of a state change
instead.use: a label, toast or aria-live text as well

components.name: AnnouncementBar
components.summary: Something that concerns everyone on every page: planned maintenance, an ongoing incident, a policy change.

instead.when: A message about one page or section
Feedback on an action just taken
Something that needs a decision before going on

components.name: AreaChart
components.summary: One quantity over time where the volume matters: traffic, requests, storage used.

instead.when: Comparing several trends that don’t add up
A trend inside a row or card

components.name: AspectRatio
components.summary: Media whose box must keep its shape before it loads: previews, thumbnails, video, maps.

instead.use: normal layout — text needs to grow

instead.when: Images that must be shown whole at their own ratio
instead.use: a plain img with width only

components.name: Attachment
components.summary: Showing a file that’s already attached: in a message, a ticket, a list of uploads.

instead.when: Uploading several files by drag and drop

components.name: Autocomplete
components.summary: Free text where common values are worth suggesting: a hostname, a city, a recent search.

instead.when: The value must be one of the options

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: Showing who: a person, a team or an account next to their name — in lists, comments, menus.

instead.when: Several people in a small space

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.summary: Showing that several people are involved — collaborators, assignees, viewers — when the exact list is secondary.

instead.when: When people need to know exactly who

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A short status or label attached to something: “Active”, “Beta”, “Expired”.

instead.when: Something people click, select or remove
A dot-only live status in a dense list

components.name: BadgeIndicator
components.summary: A count or a “something new” dot on an icon, avatar or nav item: unread notifications, pending invites.

instead.when: A status that needs a word (“Active”, “Expired”)
Live status next to a text label in a list
A number people need to read precisely

components.name: BarChart
components.summary: Comparing a value across categories: load by region, deploys per day, tickets per team.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Showing where a page sits in a hierarchy of three or more levels, and letting people go up.

instead.when: Flat sites with one or two levels

components.name: Button
components.summary: To do something: save, submit, create, delete, start a flow, open a dialog.

instead.when: Going to another page or section
instead.use: a link, or Button asChild around an <a>

instead.when: Switching a setting on or off
Choosing one of a few options
Several related actions that don’t fit side by side

components.name: Calendar
components.summary: The calendar is the content: picking a booking day, showing availability, choosing several days.

instead.when: A date field in a form
A range field in a form

components.name: Card
components.summary: A self-contained unit people scan and compare: an item in a grid, the summary of one object, a settings section.

components.name: CardFan
components.summary: A playful group of 3–5 cards in a hero or an about page: team members, plans, product shots.

instead.when: More than five cards, or cards people compare

components.name: CardStack
components.summary: A landing or empty-state showcase that cycles a few cards: testimonials, highlights, recent invoices.

instead.when: Content the user has to read or act on

components.name: Carousel
components.summary: Browsing a set of similar, optional items one or a few at a time: templates, screenshots, product photos.

instead.when: Key messages or anything people must see
instead.use: show it on the page — later slides are rarely seen

components.name: ChartRangeSelection
components.summary: Selecting a span on an ordered x-axis to zoom in or filter: “show errors from Aug 3 to Aug 6”.

components.name: Chat
components.summary: A conversation surface: an AI assistant, support chat, comments thread in real time.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Independent yes/no choices that apply when the form is saved.

instead.when: A setting that takes effect immediately

components.name: CheckboxGroup
components.summary: Several related yes/no choices that form one value (“Notify me by: Email, SMS”).

instead.when: Unrelated settings that only share a page

components.name: Chip
components.summary: Selectable or removable values: quick filters (“Critical”, “Mine”), selected tags, suggestions.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.summary: A command, snippet or config the user reads and copies: install steps, a DNS record, an API example.

instead.when: A streaming log or console output
Showing what changed between two versions
One short token inside a sentence (a path, a flag)
A single secret or value to copy, like an API key

components.name: CodeEditor
components.summary: Editing config, templates, rules or scripts in the product: JSON, HTML, CSS, JS/TS, shell.

instead.when: A short snippet to read and copy

components.name: Collapsible
components.summary: One optional region people expand on demand: “Advanced settings”, “Show 12 more”, technical details.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.summary: Any color, including custom: brand and theme colors, chart series, white-label setup.

components.name: Combobox
components.summary: Picking from a long list people search rather than scroll: regions, users, domains.

instead.when: Free text where suggestions only help
Searching content, not choosing a value

components.name: Command
components.summary: A ⌘K palette (`CommandDialog`): jump to any page or run any action by typing.

instead.when: Choosing a value for a form field
Searching content and showing results on a page

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.summary: High-stakes, irreversible deletes where a click isn’t enough: `confirmValue` makes people type the name.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.summary: A right-click shortcut in tool-like surfaces: a file grid, a canvas, a code editor, a kanban card.

instead.when: The only way to reach an action
Content pages and forms (people expect the browser menu)

components.name: CopyButton
components.summary: Next to a value people paste somewhere else: an API key, a DNS record, a command, a link.

instead.when: A secret that should stay masked until asked

instead.use: a Share action or the URL itself

components.name: CountUp
components.summary: A headline figure on a landing page: “12,400 sites”, “99.98% uptime”, “3× faster”.

instead.when: A live value in product UI (it must read correctly the moment it’s seen)
Numbers people compare in a table

components.name: Countdown
components.summary: Time left until a deadline that matters to the user: a trial ending, a maintenance window starting, “resend code in 0:42”.

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: Lists of records people scan, sort, filter, select and act on: sites, domains, invoices, users.

instead.when: Cards with images or rich content

components.name: DataTableCell
components.summary: Every cell of a DataTable: pick the kind by content — text, mono, primary, status, badge, usage, sparkline.

instead.use: the matching component: Badge, StatusDot, TextField…

instead.when: Editing many fields of one row
instead.use: a Drawer or a detail page

components.name: DataTableToolbar
components.summary: Above a selectable DataTable: filter / search when idle, bulk actions when rows are selected — in the same strip.

instead.when: A table without selection or filters

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: One date near today that people pick by looking at a month: a start date, a due date, a delivery day.

instead.when: A date people know by heart, far from today (birth date, card expiry)

components.name: DateRangePicker
components.summary: A start and end date picked together: a report period, a booking, a filter.

instead.use: Select or ToggleGroup — add a Custom option that opens this

instead.when: A time span within a day

components.name: DateTimePicker
components.summary: A moment that needs both date and time: a scheduled send, a maintenance window, a reminder.

components.name: DensityToggle
components.summary: Products with data-heavy screens (tables, admin forms), where some people want more rows on screen and others want larger targets.

instead.use: default or comfortable; compact controls drop to 24–36px

components.name: DescriptionList
components.summary: Properties of one object: site details, an invoice header, a certificate.

instead.when: Several objects with the same fields

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A short, focused task that needs an answer before going on: rename, invite, a form of a few fields.

instead.when: Long forms, or content people compare with the page
A message that needs no answer
Extra detail next to a control

components.name: DiffViewer
components.summary: Reviewing a change before applying it: config, a template, a policy, a file restored from backup.

instead.when: Comparing structured records field by field
instead.use: DescriptionList or a table with old / new columns

components.name: DonutChart
components.summary: Parts of one whole, up to 7: storage by environment, plan mix, traffic by source.

instead.when: Comparing values that aren’t parts of a whole
More than 7 parts, or many tiny slices

components.name: DotSeparator
components.summary: Separating short inline facts on one line: “eu-west-1 · Created Mar 2026 · v2.4.0”.

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: Short, touch-first tasks from the bottom of a phone screen: sort, filters, share, a few actions.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.summary: Secondary actions behind a trigger: “more actions” for a row or card, a user menu, a split button’s options.

instead.when: Choosing a value for a form field
The one or two actions people use most

components.name: Dropzone
components.summary: Uploading one or several files where dragging from the desktop is common: documents, media, imports.

instead.when: A single file in a form

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: A list, table or section with nothing in it yet — explain what will appear and how to start.

components.name: Fab
components.summary: The one main action of a screen that must stay reachable while scrolling, mostly on mobile: “New message”, “Add site”.

instead.when: Screens with more than one equally important action
instead.use: Button in the page header or StickyActionBar

instead.when: Desktop pages where the action fits in the header
Two to five related create actions behind one button

components.name: FeedbackWidget
components.summary: “Was this helpful?” at the end of a help article, a docs page or an AI answer.

instead.when: Rating a product, order or support case

instead.use: a form or a support channel
ask after the task is done

components.name: Field
components.summary: Stacking a Label, a control, a description and an error for controls that don’t draw them themselves (Select, Combobox, DatePicker, custom).

instead.when: TextField / TextArea — label, description and error are built in

components.name: Fieldset
components.summary: Grouping related controls under one name: an address, notification settings, a section of a long form.

instead.use: Label or the field’s own label

instead.when: Visual grouping only, nothing to name
A group of checkboxes as one value

components.name: File
components.summary: One file in a form: a logo, a certificate, a document to attach.

instead.when: Several files at once, or drag and drop is the main way in

components.name: Filter
components.summary: Narrowing a list or table by a few facets: status, region, owner.

components.name: FilterField
components.summary: Keyword search and filtering by many attributes in one field: servers, logs, users.

components.name: Form
components.summary: Forms with validation on react-hook-form: FormField per control, FormItem with FormLabel, FormDescription and FormMessage.

instead.when: One or two fields with no validation logic
Editing an object’s properties in a side panel

components.name: HelpIcon
components.summary: One line of optional background next to a label, a column header or a stat: what a term means, why a setting exists.

instead.when: Instructions needed to fill a field

instead.use: a description, Popover or docs link

components.name: HoldToTalk
components.summary: Voice input in a prompt or chat composer, where speaking replaces typing for one message.

instead.when: Long dictation or a recorder with pause and review

components.name: HoverCard
components.summary: A quick preview of what a link points to — a user, a site, a ticket — that people could also get by clicking.

instead.when: Anything people must reach on touch
A short label for an icon

components.name: ImageCropper
components.summary: Framing an uploaded image before saving: avatar, logo, cover, product photo.

instead.when: Images shown at their own proportions

components.name: InlineEdit
components.summary: Renaming one value where it’s shown: a site name, a page title, a note.

instead.when: Values that need confirmation or have consequences (a domain, an email)
Something people edit all the time

components.name: InputGroup
components.summary: A fixed prefix or suffix that is part of the value’s format: https://, .theya.app, /mo, GB.

components.name: InputOTP
components.summary: A one-time code of known length from an SMS, email or authenticator app.

instead.when: Codes of varying length, or recovery codes with dashes
Anything that isn’t a code (PINs people set themselves)

components.name: Kanban
components.summary: Work moving through stages: tickets, a deploy pipeline, content review.

instead.when: Many fields per item to compare

components.name: Kbd
components.summary: Showing a keyboard key or shortcut in text, menus, tooltips and help: ⌘ K, Esc, ?.

components.name: KebabIcon
components.summary: The trigger of an overflow menu: “more actions” for a row, a card or a toolbar.

instead.when: A truncated path or pagination gap

components.name: KeyboardShortcuts
components.summary: A help dialog listing an app’s shortcuts, opened from a menu or with “?”.

instead.when: One shortcut next to its action
instead.use: Kbd in the menu item or tooltip

components.name: Label
components.summary: Naming any form control that doesn’t draw its own label — Select, Combobox, DatePicker, NumberField, custom controls.

instead.when: TextField and TextArea — they take a label prop

components.name: Lightbox
components.summary: Looking closely at images — screenshots, product photos, attachments — and moving through a set.

instead.when: Small images that are already readable

components.name: LineChart
components.summary: Comparing a few trends over the same time: CPU vs memory, this week vs last.

instead.use: small multiples, or let people pick series

components.name: Link
components.summary: Going somewhere: another page, a section, a document, an external site.

instead.when: Doing something: save, delete, open a dialog
A navigation item in a menu or sidebar
A whole card that leads somewhere

components.name: ListItem
components.summary: Lists lighter than a table: settings sections, notifications, a resource picker.

instead.when: Picking one of a few options

components.name: Marquee
components.summary: A strip of customer logos, short quotes or partner names on a landing page — “trusted by”.

instead.when: Content people need to read or act on

components.name: MarqueeColumns
components.summary: A decorative wall of cards behind or beside a hero: testimonials, templates, integrations.

instead.when: A single row of logos or short items
Cards people need to read or click in order

components.name: MaskedInput
components.summary: A value with one fixed format people type character by character: a card number, an IPv4 address, a date in a fixed form.

components.name: Menubar
components.summary: An application-style menu bar for editors and tools: File, Edit, View, each with many commands.

components.name: Message
components.summary: One turn in a conversation, inside ChatMessages.

instead.when: System notices in a transcript (“Agent joined”)

components.name: MessagePopup
components.summary: A help or AI assistant that lives in a corner while the page stays usable beside it.

components.name: Meter
components.summary: How full something is within a known range: disk, memory, a quota, seats used.

instead.when: How far along a running task is

components.name: Metric
components.summary: Quick-glance counts repeated as rows inside a card: mailboxes used, aliases, records pending.

instead.when: A headline KPI that stands alone
Usage against a limit that needs a bar

components.name: NavigationMenu
components.summary: A horizontal site or product header with a few top-level sections, some opening a panel of links.

components.name: NumberField
components.summary: A count or amount people adjust in small steps: quantity, seats, retention days, CPU cores.

instead.when: Numbers that aren’t amounts: card, phone, postcode
Rough values where precision doesn’t matter

components.name: OptionCard
components.summary: A one-of choice where each option needs a title, a line of explanation and often a price: plans, verification methods, delivery.

components.name: OrbitCarousel
components.summary: A showcase on a landing page: case studies, product shots, a few campaign cards.

instead.when: Content people browse or compare in the product
More than ~10 cards, or cards with forms and long text

components.name: PageHeader
components.summary: The top of a page or major section: title, a line of description, and the page’s main action on the right.

instead.use: a heading, or PageHeader with as="h2"

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Long lists and tables split into pages people jump between: search results, logs, invoices.

instead.use: a “Load more” button or infinite scroll

components.name: Password
components.summary: Signing in, setting or changing a password — with show/hide.

instead.when: API keys and tokens shown to the person

components.name: PasswordStrengthMeter
components.summary: Under a new-password field, to show how close the password is to the rules as it’s typed.

components.name: PhoneField
components.summary: Any phone number: account, 2FA by SMS, contact details.

components.name: Popover
components.summary: A small panel tied to a control: a quick setting, a filter, a picker, extra details on tap.

instead.when: A short label for an icon
Forms with required fields, or a decision

components.name: Price
components.summary: Any amount of money in the UI: plan cards, checkout, invoices, add-ons.

instead.when: A column of amounts in a table

components.name: ProductTour
components.summary: Introducing what changed on a redesigned screen, once, in 2–5 steps.

instead.use: docs, or an empty state with guidance
Help content they can come back to

components.name: Progress
components.summary: A task with a known percent done: upload, restore, export, install.

instead.when: Content loading for the first time
A background task people shouldn’t wait on

components.name: ProgressRing
components.summary: A single completion figure on a card or a landing bento: setup 75% done, 3 of 4 steps.

instead.when: A value that updates live (upload, CPU)

components.name: PromptArea
components.summary: The composer of a chat or AI assistant: multi-line input that grows, send and stop, attachments, @mentions and /commands.

components.name: PromptSuggestions
components.summary: Starting points above an empty composer — what the assistant is good at, as tap-to-ask prompts.

instead.use: short reply chips under the last answer

components.name: PropertyGrid
components.summary: Viewing and editing an object’s properties in a compact two-column list: an inspector panel, a resource’s settings, a selected item’s details.

instead.when: A form people fill once (sign-up, checkout)
Many records with the same fields

components.name: Prose
components.summary: Long-form content Theya doesn’t lay out itself: help articles, changelogs, legal pages, rendered Markdown or CMS HTML.

instead.when: App UI — forms, cards, tables you build

components.name: PushSheet
components.summary: Details of a selected item beside the list, while the list stays usable: inspect, compare, pick the next one.

instead.when: Tasks that must be finished or cancelled

components.name: QrCode
components.summary: Moving something from screen to phone: 2FA setup, a Wi-Fi or app link, a payment or ticket.

instead.when: The user is already on the phone

instead.use: a download or a short link in the code

components.name: QueryBuilder
components.summary: Saved segments, alert rules, automation triggers — conditions people compose and come back to.

instead.when: Filtering a list on the spot

components.name: Radio
components.summary: Exactly one of 2–5 options, all visible so people can compare them.

instead.when: Options that need a picture, price or several lines

components.name: RangeField
components.summary: A numeric range people set roughly and sometimes exactly: price filter, size, response time.

components.name: Rating
components.summary: Leaving a 1–5 score (review form).

instead.when: Satisfaction on a labelled scale (“Very poor … Excellent”)

components.name: Resizable
components.summary: Work views where people balance two or three panes themselves: file tree + editor, list + details, editor + preview.

instead.when: Page layout that should just adapt
A details panel that opens and closes

components.name: Reveal
components.summary: Landing and marketing pages: feature blocks, cards, a pricing row easing in as the reader scrolls down.

instead.when: Product UI — dashboards, forms, tables, settings
instead.use: no motion: content should just be there

instead.when: Something appearing because of a user action
instead.use: Collapsible, Dialog or the component’s own transition

components.name: RichTextEditor
components.summary: Text that is published or sent with formatting: announcements, product descriptions, email templates, ticket replies.

instead.use: a dedicated editor or a doc tool

components.name: Scheduler
components.summary: Events placed in time: maintenance windows, bookings, shifts, release plans.

instead.when: Picking a date or a range
Work by stage, not by time

components.name: ScrollArea
components.summary: A region that must scroll inside a fixed space: a list in a popover or panel, a log, a long menu.

instead.when: Nested scroll inside scroll on mobile

components.name: SecretField
components.summary: Showing a secret the person needs to copy: API key, token, webhook secret, recovery code.

components.name: Select
components.summary: One choice from 6–15 known options (up to 5 → RadioGroup, over 15 → Combobox).

instead.when: Up to 5 options — show them all

components.name: Separator
components.summary: A quiet line between groups that spacing alone doesn’t separate: menu groups, list rows, toolbar sections.

components.name: Sidebar
components.summary: App navigation with several sections people switch between all day.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: First load of content whose shape is known: a card, a list, a profile header.

instead.when: A task with known percent done
Reloading data that is already shown
instead.use: keep the old data and show a subtle busy state

components.name: Slider
components.summary: A value where roughly right is good enough and seeing the position helps: volume, concurrency, a budget.

instead.when: A range people also want to type

components.name: Toaster
components.summary: Short feedback on an action just taken: saved, sent, copied, failed.

instead.when: An error people must fix on this page (form, field)

components.name: Sparkline
components.summary: The shape of a trend next to its number: a stat card, a table cell, a list row.

instead.when: When people need values, axes or comparisons

instead.use: show the number, or a full chart

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: A short wait inside a control or a small area: a button that is saving, a list that is loading, a file being read.

instead.when: A whole page or a layout that is loading
Work with a known amount done

components.name: SplitButton
components.summary: One main action with a few variations of it: “Deploy” / Deploy to staging / Deploy without cache.

instead.when: When none of the options is clearly the default

components.name: Stat
components.summary: Headline numbers on a dashboard or overview: active sites, uptime, revenue — 2 to 4 in a row.

instead.when: Counts repeated as rows in a card
A trend people need to read

components.name: StatusDot
components.summary: Live state next to its text label: Running, Stopped, Degraded, Online.

instead.when: A status that should stand out
A count or “new” mark on an icon

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: A process done in order over several screens: onboarding, checkout, a setup wizard.

instead.when: Sections people visit in any order

components.name: StickyActionBar
components.summary: Save / Discard at the end of a long form, kept in view while scrolling.

components.name: SuccessCheck
components.summary: The moment something succeeds: a success Alert or Toast, a finished step, a "Saved" confirmation.

instead.when: A success state that is already on screen when the page opens (a list of passed checks)
Many items at once (every row of a table)
instead.use: a static icon — one drawing at a time

components.name: SurfaceEffect
components.summary: Feature and pricing cards on a landing page: a glow under the pointer (`spotlight`), a light running round the border of the plan you recommend (`beam`), a gentle `tilt`, `shine` or `lift` on hover.

instead.when: Cards in product UI (lists, dashboards, settings)
A way to say “this one is selected” or “this is clickable”
instead.use: Card selectable / action — the effect is decoration only

components.name: SwatchPicker
components.summary: Choosing by look: product color or material, a label color, a color facet in a filter.

components.name: SwipeDeck
components.summary: A quick keep-or-skip pass over a short set: templates to try, suggested domains, onboarding interests.

instead.when: Choosing several items the user needs to compare side by side

components.name: Switch
components.summary: A setting that takes effect the moment it’s flipped — no Save button.

instead.when: A choice that applies when a form is submitted
Two named options that aren’t on/off (Monthly / Yearly)
A button that starts an action

components.name: Table
components.summary: Static tabular data with a few rows and no sorting, paging or selection: a price breakdown, DNS records, a spec sheet.

instead.when: Label / value pairs about one object
Laying out a form or a page
Rows with one main item and an action

components.name: TableSkeleton
components.summary: First load of a hand-built Table: real headers, skeleton rows.

instead.use: keep them and show a busy state

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Switching between views of the same object: Overview, Settings, Logs.

instead.when: Steps people go through in order
A tab state that should survive reload or be shared

components.name: TagInput
components.summary: Several free-form values of one kind: email recipients, domains, IP ranges, tags.

instead.when: Picking several from a known list

components.name: Terminal
components.summary: Live or past console output: a web SSH session, a deploy or build log, a tail of access logs.

instead.when: A command for the user to copy
A list of events people browse or filter

components.name: TextEffect
components.summary: A hero headline or one key word on a landing page: letters rising in (`split`), a code-like reveal (`scramble`), a soft highlight (`shimmer`), rotating phrases (`typewriter`).

instead.when: Body copy, labels, buttons, anything in product UI
Text people must read quickly (prices, warnings)

components.name: TextField
components.summary: Short free text on one line: a name, an email, a domain, a URL, a code.

instead.when: More than a line of text
A number people step up and down

components.name: TextArea
components.summary: Text that can run to several lines: a description, a message, notes, a list one per line.

components.name: ThemeToggle
components.summary: A quick light/dark switch in the top bar.

instead.when: When “same as system” must be a choice too
instead.use: a radio group in the account menu or settings

components.name: TickerList
components.summary: A few rows of recent activity inside a showcase card: transactions, signups, deploys.

instead.when: A real activity feed people scroll and act on

components.name: TimeField
components.summary: A time of day: a daily backup time, a meeting start, a reminder.

components.name: TimeRangePicker
components.summary: A start and end time within one day: opening hours, a maintenance window, quiet hours.

components.name: Timeline
components.summary: A sequence of events in time: activity on a site, an incident’s history, an order’s progress.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: A button that stays pressed: bold in an editor, “Show archived”, pin.

instead.when: A setting with a label and an immediate effect

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.summary: Switching a view or a filter among 2–5 options, all visible: Grid / List, All / Unread, Monthly / Yearly.

instead.when: A choice in a form that’s saved later

components.name: ToneIcon
components.summary: Leading a row or card whose meaning is a tone: a warning in a list, a success step, an info note.

instead.when: A live state on a small item

components.name: Toolbar
components.summary: A row of related commands sharing one tab stop: bulk actions on a selection, text formatting, editor tools.

instead.use: a search region with normal tab order

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Naming an icon-only control (“Copy API key”) or adding a short hint to something focusable.

instead.when: Information people need to complete a task
instead.use: text on the page or a field description

components.name: Topbar
components.summary: The app header above the content: breadcrumb or page context on the left, a few global actions on the right.

components.name: Tree
components.summary: Real hierarchy people expand and pick from: files and folders, DNS zones, nested categories.

components.name: UndoToast
components.summary: A destructive action that can be held back for a few seconds: delete a file, archive a site, remove a member.

instead.when: The action can’t be rolled back (data wiped, email sent, payment)

components.name: UrlTabs
components.summary: Page-level tabs people link to, share, or return to after reload: a resource’s Settings or Billing tab.

instead.when: Tabs inside a dialog, popover or card
Several tab groups on one page sharing a param

components.name: UsageBar
components.summary: A total split into up to four parts: storage by type, bandwidth by site, seats by role.

instead.when: Many parts or comparing over time

components.name: WheelPicker
components.summary: Picking one value from a short ordered scale — an interval, a duration, a size — where nudging up or down is the natural gesture.

instead.when: Up to five options that should all be visible
